Codex review (harness/state/1h/reviews/H.3.json) found R-1 (shared TID251 per-file ignores cross-exempted both bans) and R-2 (handled _timed failures added a WARNING line to CLI stderr). Fix 2c5e71d: no TID251 per-file ignore under src/; six reasoned line-level '# noqa: TID251' exemptions (two in server/environment.py, three in adapters/secretstore_local/store.py, one in sdk/tasks.py), pinned exactly by test_banned_api_allowlist_is_pinned with cross-ban tests (test_allowed_files_still_ban_the_other_api); _timed passes log_failure=False because its task is an awaited child the caller handles; tests/unit/kernel/test_timed_logging.py proves a handled lost-response failure logs nothing and reaches NEEDS_RECONCILIATION.
